messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync 1 we need to land a clear proposal for long-term routing + multi-region isolation so Q3 initiatives arent blocked. customers keep filing asks.
Ajay Singh: agreed. core tension: hard tenant fencing vs cost and utilization. some enterprise customers need cryptographic separation.
Nora Chen: suggestion: two launch paths — Tier A (regional isolation, soft guarantees + strong telemetry) and Tier B (full tenant fencing, dedicated pools, compliance review).
Maya Patel: proposal for Tier A launch criteria: documented failure modes and mitigations, canary rollout plan (10% traffic), per-tenant SLO baselines, migration/evacuation playbook, and observability hooks.
Samir Rao: infra note: can we implement Tier A without separate routing fabric? a feature-flagged isolation mode on current fabric could speed delivery but increases complexity.
Ajay Singh: feature-flag approach acceptable for Tier A if we have: eviction policy, capacity gating, and automated circuit-breaker for noisy tenants.
Nora Chen: customers keep asking for: per-tenant bandwidth caps, geo-locking (region pinning), and exportable audit trails. those map to routing + network policies + logging.
Maya Patel: also need telemetry requirements: token-level latency percentiles, per-route error budgets, rollout health endpoint for canary gates.
Samir Rao: KV cache issue: current shared LRU can get thrash if one tenant streams long contexts. for Tier A we should enforce per-tenant cache quotas and eviction priorities.
Ajay Singh: ops rollout sketch: local dev 1 internal beta with 2 customers 1 staged canaries at 1%, 5%, 10% 1 broad. fallback policy: route to a compatible model variant or alternate region when gating fails.
Maya Patel: decision call: require dedicated capacity for Tier A? I'm inclined to keep shared pools with strict quotas and auto-evac, reduces cost and speeds adoption.
Nora Chen: compliance flagged: certain regulated customers will require dedicated pools. propose default = shared, opt-in dedicated after compliance review & contract. call that "shared-by-default, dedicated-on-request".
Samir Rao: sample routing YAML for gating prototype:
```
routing:
  policy: tenant_affinity
  isolation_tier: TierA
  cache_quota_mb: 256
  bandwidth_cap_mbps: 50
  failover_strategy: regional_preference
  canary_enabled: true
```
Ajay Singh: good. Action items: Maya to draft launch criteria doc, Samir to run cache + eviction sizing experiments, Nora to consolidate customer priority matrix and compliance redlines.
Maya Patel: timeline: draft by EOD Friday, internal beta mid-July. please ack and call out blockers. :thumbsup:
Ajay Singh: ack.
Nora Chen: ack 1 pinging compliance this afternoon.
Samir Rao: ack 1 running sims now, will post results here.
infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: canary job started for "routing-tierA-canary" at 1746663450.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone 1 flag any customer-specific constraints in-thread. we'll iterate on the spec here.
